verdict.rationale: Bruno's marketing and README explicitly state 'no cloud sync, no account, no login... zero visibility into your requests' and that collections stay in local files, indicating no telemetry/usage tracking is collected by design rather than needing an opt-out toggle. This satisfies the privacy intent of the story, though there's no explicit 'telemetry settings' page or independent audit confirming zero background telemetry in the CLI/desktop app. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry opt-out setting/documentation, and independent verification (e.g. network traffic audit) confirming no telemetry calls.
